enable_feature.description: Comma separated feature names to enable. Valid options: promql-experimental-functions, promql-delayed-name-removal, promql-duration-expr, promql-extended-range-selectors.

query_lookback_delta.description: The server's maximum query lookback duration.

check_config_lint.description: Linting checks to apply to the rules/scrape configs specified in the config. Available options are: all, duplicate-rules, none, too-long-scrape-interval.

check_config_lint_fatal.description: Make lint errors exit with exit code 3.

check_config_syntax_only.description: Only check the config file syntax, ignoring file and content validation referenced in the config.

check_config_agent.description: Check config file for Prometheus in Agent mode.

check_service_discovery.description: Service discovery checks to perform. Each item must contain timeout, config_file, and job.

check_service_discovery.timeout.description: The time to wait for discovery results.

check_service_discovery.job.description: The job to run service discovery for.

check_healthy_url.description: The URL for the Prometheus server.

check_ready_url.description: The URL for the Prometheus server.

check_rules_lint.description: Linting checks to apply. Available options are: all, duplicate-rules, none.

check_rules_lint_fatal.description: Make lint errors exit with exit code 3.

check_rules_ignore_unknown_fields.description: Ignore unknown fields in the rule files.

query_instant_time.description: Query evaluation time (RFC3339 or Unix timestamp).

query_range_start.description: Query range start time (RFC3339 or Unix timestamp).

query_range_end.description: Query range end time (RFC3339 or Unix timestamp).

push_metrics_remote_url.description: Prometheus remote write url to push metrics.

push_metrics_timeout.description: The time to wait for pushing metrics.

test_rules.description: Unit tests for rules. Each item must contain run and test_rule_file.

test_rules.run.description: If set, will only run test groups whose names match the regular expression.

test_rules.diff.description: Print colored differential output between expected & received output.

tsdb_analyze.description: Analyze churn, label pair cardinality and compaction efficiency. Each item must contain db_path and optionally limit, extended, match.

tsdb_analyze.limit.description: How many items to show in each list.

tsdb_dump.description: Dump data from a TSDB. Each item must contain db_path and optionally min_time, max_time, match.

tsdb_dump.min_time.description: Minimum timestamp to dump, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

tsdb_dump.max_time.description: Maximum timestamp to dump, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

tsdb_bench_write.description: Run a write performance benchmark. Each item must contain file, out, metrics, scrapes.
